subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill In the blank.

He was _____ injured, but recovered very soon.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's see the meaning of the sentence and the words given in the options.
 
 
• Butt word is showing contrast here.
 
• **Injured **is a verb here and we need an **adverb **that will describe it.
 
• "But" is used for introducing an idea that contrasts with or is different from what has just been said
 
• **Recovered very soon** is the meaning of the second sentence.
 
• It means that the first sentence should be the contrast.
 
• The person who was seriously injured takes more time to recover
 
• So according to the context of the sentence, The correct answer is "**Seriously".**
 
 
 
• **Hence, **the correct answer is serious.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Simply (Adv):- used to emphasize how easy or basic something is
